comment: How JS authenticates to APIs (0.48.0; trimmed 0.52.0 to auth-bearing signals only). Scanned against JS bodies only (JsAnalyzer). Passive; the 'note' says how to use it. Bounded spans (ReDoS). Reported non-sensitive. Categorized API by FindingTaxonomy.

patterns.name: XHR request header (auth)
patterns.note: see where this header's value comes from -- if it's a hardcoded/derivable token, extract it and replay requests (or strip it to test for missing server-side auth)

patterns.name: Authorization header in request
patterns.note: trace the token's origin; replay the request with a lower-priv token (or none) to check server-side enforcement; decode a JWT for weak alg/claims

patterns.name: API key header
patterns.note: if the key is hardcoded in the JS it's exposed to every user -- extract it and test its scope/rate limits against the API
